simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָב (H5646) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: עָב (ʻâb) means an architrave (as shading the pillars) First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 7 6.

definitions.full: H5646. ab or ob I. עָב , [ עֹב ] noun masculine architectural term, meaning unknown; projecting roof is conjectured (Sm Co Berthol); others landing (Da); AV RV thick beam or plank , RVm threshold ; Benz Kit Toy leave untranslated; in any case a structure of wood; — absolute וְעָב וְעַמֻּדִים 1Kin 7:6 ; apparently construct מֵהַחוּץ הָאוּלָם אֶלמְּֿנֵי עֵץ וְעָב Ezek 41:25 ; plural (si vera lectio) הָעֻבִּים 41:26 . II. עָב see עוּב .
definitions.rootNote: or עֹב ; from an unused root meaning to cover; properly, equivalent to 5645 ; but used only as an architectural term,
